description: Ministry of Skills Development & Vocational Training - Order of the Provisions of the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (CGTTI) Act will be effective from 25.08.2017.
categorisation: This gazette content focuses on the implementation of a specific act (the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute Act No. 15 of 2017) and the minister's order regarding its effective date. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and the implementation of legislation, falling clearly under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While a minister is named, the primary purpose is regulatory implementation rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel announcement.
